title: Preserve navigation targets and jumps on each measure
scope: Retain every navigation marker on a measure, including simultaneous target and jump markers from GP5 and GPIF.
acceptance: Preserve Coda, Segno and Fine targets together with applicable Da Capo/Da Segno jumps on one measure.
Define one authority between the existing Direction pointer and the new semantic representation, including post-parse edits.
GP5 and GPIF fixtures retain the exact marker set in GP8 as read by pinned AlphaTab.
exclusions: Do not implement a playback engine or repeat traversal.

reproduction.instructions: Reproduce via the public Go parser and GP8 exporter, then load original and output with pinned AlphaTab. The observed end-to-end difference alone does not locate the failing stage.

evidence.detail: Public contract; linked matrix cases are in obligation.

Checked all five targets and fourteen jumps, GP5 and GPIF import, simultaneous markers, deterministic deduplication, legacy-pointer versus collection edit/clear authority, and pinned-consumer output. Navigation traversal remains excluded.
commands: prek run --all-files: PASS on clean audited commit
ALPHATAB_CONFORMANCE=1 focused existing acceptance tests: PASS

resolution: MeasureHeader.Directions now preserves the complete canonical navigation-marker set while Direction remains a documented legacy singleton view. GP5 collects all 19 table entries in stable order, GPIF imports and audits repeated Target and Jump values, validation follows the reconciled edit authority, and GP8 emits exact direction tokens without mutating authored slices. Focused tests cover real GP5 and GPIF fixtures, simultaneous markers, duplicate removal, post-parse slice and legacy edits, invalid values, exact XML, GP8 reimport, and pinned AlphaTab consumption. Playback traversal remains out of scope.
